activities.title: Make their day a little easier
activities.description: Choose one small kindness that would help your partner today.
steps: Ask what would make today easier.
Choose something you can comfortably do.
Let them know when it is done.
activities.alternative: A thoughtful message or a little listening counts too.

activities.title: A song, just for you
activities.description: Find a song that makes you think of your partner.
steps: Each choose a song.
Share it in your chat or listen together.
Tell each other why you picked it.
activities.alternative: You can share lyrics in your own words or describe a sound you love.

activities.title: Notice the little things
activities.description: Make appreciation specific, and give it a little time.
steps: Notice something your partner did recently.
Tell them what it meant to you.
Take turns listening without rushing.
activities.alternative: Speak, type, or record a voice message in your private chat.

activities.title: A small welcome
activities.description: Make your next hello a little more thoughtful.
steps: Think about what helps your partner feel welcome.
Prepare a small gesture or message.
Give each other a moment to enjoy it.
activities.alternative: A warm text works just as well as an in-person gesture.

name: Quality time
subtitle: Make a little room for each other

activities.title: Fifteen minutes for us
activities.description: Give each other a little undivided attention.
steps: Choose a comfortable moment together.
Put other distractions aside.
Spend fifteen minutes talking, listening, or simply being together.
activities.alternative: Use a call, text exchange, or a shorter session if that suits you.

activities.title: Take the slow way
activities.description: Share a gentle walk and notice your surroundings.
steps: Choose somewhere comfortable and accessible.
Walk together or call from your own places.
Each point out something you might usually miss.
activities.alternative: Stay seated by a window and share what you notice instead.

activities.title: A quiet cup together
activities.description: Turn a familiar drink into a little shared pause.
steps: Make a drink you already have.
Sit together or connect on a call.
Enjoy it without trying to solve anything.
activities.alternative: Water and a brief text exchange are equally welcome.

activities.title: Revisit a good day
activities.description: Spend a little time with a memory you both enjoy.
steps: Choose a shared day or experience.
Each recall one detail.
Listen for something you had forgotten.
activities.alternative: No photos are needed; a spoken or typed memory is enough.

activities.title: Two-minute portraits
activities.description: Draw each other with curiosity and a little humour.
steps: Find paper or a drawing app.
Take two minutes to draw each other.
Share your pictures privately and name your favourite detail.
activities.alternative: Describe an imaginary portrait aloud if drawing is not comfortable.

activities.title: Our tiny treasure hunt
activities.description: Find ordinary objects that tell a little story.
steps: Each find something soft, something colourful, and something meaningful.
Take turns showing or describing your finds.
Tell the story behind the meaningful one.
activities.alternative: Choose things within reach or imagine your three objects.

activities.title: Build a silly story
activities.description: Create a story neither of you could have written alone.
steps: One of you starts with a sentence.
Take turns adding one sentence each.
Give your story a title together.
activities.alternative: Type or speak; there is no timer and no wrong answer.

activities.title: A living-room dance
activities.description: Find a little movement that feels like you.
steps: Choose a song you both enjoy.
Make room to move comfortably.
Dance, sway, or tap along together.
activities.alternative: Seated movement or simply listening together counts.

activities.title: Cook something new together
activities.description: Try a simple dish neither of you has made before.
steps: Choose an easy recipe that suits both of you.
Share the preparation in a way that feels fair.
Sit down and enjoy what you made.
activities.alternative: Assemble a simple snack if cooking or equipment is not accessible.

activities.title: Learn one little thing
activities.description: Follow your curiosity together for a few minutes.
steps: Choose a small skill or topic you both like.
Find a short free guide or demonstration.
Try it together and share what surprised you.
activities.alternative: Choose something that fits your energy, access, and available materials.

activities.title: Explore a nearby corner
activities.description: Look at a familiar place with fresh eyes.
steps: Choose a nearby, accessible place.
Notice one detail that is new to each of you.
Share what you liked about your little discovery.
activities.alternative: Explore a place virtually or share a view from home.

activities.title: Taste something differently
activities.description: Try a small new combination using what you have.
steps: Pick familiar ingredients that suit your dietary needs.
Try a new, simple combination.
Compare what you each enjoyed.
activities.alternative: Describe a combination you would like to try; buying anything is optional.
